audit.why: 50.82% Emerald+ over 1285 games with diff EVEN / 4-10 is internally consistent for a lane Mundo owns early and loses late. Left diff, diffRating and carryRating untouched.
audit.corrected: No change to diff/diffRating/carryRating. Flagged the mirror discrepancy (kassadin's page was set to HARD 7.5/10 off a 23-game sample) in questionsForUser rather than fighting it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted itself. content.win[5] and win[6] said 'Dr. Mundo', but content.whys[5] says 'stays skill-based' and whys[6] says 'Kassadin outscales hard, blinking past your slow onto the backline'. full.phases[5].side/[6].side said 'Dr. Mundo' too, with whys claiming Mundo is a raid boss at 2 items.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is [Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Skill, Skill, Kassadin]. Both the packet AND the page's own whys[] say Skill at first item and Kassadin at two items; only the side tokens disagreed. A 50.82% overall win rate fits exactly that shape - Mundo banks an early lead, Kassadin scales past him.
audit.corrected: Whole-chart flip proposed as one group: content win[5] -> Skill, win[6] -> Kassadin; full phases[5].side -> Skill (rating 5/10) and phases[6].side -> Kassadin (rating 3/10), with both whys rewritten to Riftwalk's real 5/3.5/2s cooldown. Also fixed breakdown.spikes and breakdown.late, which promised a 2-item side-lane window the chart no longer supports.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three real errors. (1) The full layer calls Mundo's Q a 'cleaver' in eight places - the ability is Infected Bonesaw. (2) Nothing anywhere mentioned Void Stone or Null Sphere's shield, and both blunt the majority of Mundo's damage. (3) tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d are built on 'no passive canister on the ground' - Kassadin's kit contains no immobilizing effect at all, so he can never drop that canister.
audit.why: Riot on Void Stone: 'Kassadin takes reduced magic damage.' Riot on Null Sphere: 'the excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Dr. Mundo's Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper are both magic damage; only E Blunt Force Trauma (physical) and his autos are not. So Kassadin passively resists, then shields against, most of what Mundo throws - and the way through is E plus auto-attacks, not Bonesaw chip. Separately, Goes Where He Pleases resists the first Immobilizing effect; Force Pulse only slows and nothing else in Kassadin's kit immobilizes, so the canister is a jungle-gank mechanic in this lane, not a laning one.
audit.corrected: Renamed cleaver -> Infected Bonesaw throughout the full layer. Wrote Void Stone + Null Sphere into report[5].t and spikes[2].text. Replaced the canister-based tradeBad/dontsFull[2].d with the real losing pattern (chasing a 500-unit, 40-mana blink and burning a 9s E on air), and moved the canister truth into report[10].t where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page was built on 'engage only on Riftwalk's cooldown' - loading, dosFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns, report[9] and winCon all repeat it. Riftwalk's cooldown is 5/3.5/2 seconds.
audit.why: You cannot wait out a 5-second blink, let alone a 2-second one. Riot's own text names the real limiter: 'Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana.' Riftwalk is 40 mana base with escalating repeat cost, Null Sphere is 60/65/70/75/80 and Force Pulse 60/65/70/75/80. His mana bar is the punishable resource, not his ultimate's cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with the real numbers (Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s, Blunt Force Trauma 9s->6s, Maximum Dosage 120s) and re-keyed loading, winCon, ahead, report[1], report[9] and dosFull[0] to his mana bar instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics that decide trades were absent: Heart Zapper's conditional heal, and Infected Bonesaw stopping on the first enemy hit.
audit.why: Heart Zapper heals 50% of stored damage on the burst by default and 100% only if the burst catches a champion or large monster - Riftwalk's 500-unit blink leaves the 325 radius for free and halves your heal. And Riot: 'dealing damage to the first enemy hit' - one minion in the line eats the whole Bonesaw, which matters because it is his only ranged tool at 975.
audit.corrected: Heart Zapper's radius and conditional heal written into tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, report[3].t and spikes[2].text. Bonesaw's first-target-only behaviour written into content.early, breakdown.early and loading.

notes: BOGUS MISSING-INTERACTION: the brief's rule 'channel-interruptible' claims Kassadin's Null Sphere is a channel that Mundo's passive cancels. Riot's text says the opposite - Null Sphere 'interrupts channels', it is not one - and Goes Where He Pleases is CC resistance, not CC. Did not write it. The kit's 'channel' flag on Kassadin Q is a tooltip-parse misfire. Also did not write the brief's 'autoreset-burst-tell' line about Nether Blade as a step-back cue: it is Kassadin's mana-sustain auto in lane and he uses it on minions constantly, so treating every wind-up as a burst tell would be false.
